Who I am

About me

I’m a Computer Applications student at MSU-IIT in Iligan City. I work with microcontrollers, sensors, and software to build useful prototypes.

My projects include real-time monitoring, computer vision, automation, and desktop applications. I’m currently part of a university-funded research project on detecting aphid damage in bell peppers using edge AI.

Beyond technical work, I teach English online and take part in student leadership and technology events.

My work

Research, course projects, and prototypes I’ve worked on.

Ongoing research

Aphid damage detection

An ongoing study using image recognition to detect aphid damage in bell peppers and show the results in an offline monitoring interface.

My role: Student researcher · Collaborative research

Tools: Raspberry Pi 5, YOLOv8n, Flask

Visit the research page

Prototype

RT-Spark activity recognition

A prototype that collects motion sensor data and sends it to a walking and running classifier. I developed Python tools to record labeled data and review trial results.

My role: Contributor · Sensor data collection & evaluation

Tools: RT-Thread, Python, MQTT/TLS
